==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Lianke:''' Oh, the [[Moon-chasing Festival]] is coming up, and last year was too swamped to get the chance to see the lanterns with my [[Xiaobao]].
:'''Lianke:''' This year is my chance to make up for it. I wonder what kind of gift would be good for the child?
:{{DIcon}} Fun toys.
::'''Lianke:''' Toys? I don't really understand the likes of children. I have to ask that kid, [[Chixia]], for help.
::'''Lianke:''' She often helps me babysit my Xiaobao, who treats her like a real sister and tells her everything.
:{{DIcon}} Delicious food.
::'''Lianke:''' Food? I work down in the mine all year round. To be honest, my knowledge of food in [[Jinzhou]] is as good as yours. So I should ask you for recommendations.
:{{DIcon}} Spend quality time with him.
::'''Lianke:''' Quality time with Xiaobao... Yes, I haven't been able to spend time with the child because of work.
::'''Lianke:''' Last year the child had a huge tantrum because he didn't see the lanterns with me, and it took a long time to calm him down.
:'''Lianke:''' Moon-chasing Festival, the festival that children are always talking about... I'm actually quite looking forward to it. To be honest, I was once one of the [[Exiles]].
:'''Lianke:''' In the past, even on the day of the Moon-chasing Festival, we had to worry about the supplies needed for survival.
:'''Lianke:''' It was only after we were accepted by Jinzhou that we started to enjoy the Moon-chasing Festival like everyone else.
:'''Lianke:''' Thank you for your suggestion. I will think about it after work...
{{Dialogue End}}
